method: Each Chainlink DON node fetched the page independently and extracted third-party hosts from static HTML (script/img/iframe/link tags and URLs in inline scripts). Only the host set agreed by consensus is recorded.

findings.rationale: Ad-tech loaded before any parental-consent gate collects persistent identifiers for advertising.

provisions.summary: A persistent identifier that can recognize a user over time and across sites is personal information.
Verifiable parental consent is required before collecting personal information from a child.
Disclosure to third parties, e.g. for targeted advertising, needs separate parental consent.
A child-directed site is responsible for third parties it lets collect personal information on its pages.
